about: lib/colour-name.js colourName(hex, lang, { known }): a colour's plain name, never its code (Turki, Nov 27 2026). The spool's own name wins; else the nearest everyday name within CIEDE2000 18; else null (the swatch alone). The first two are Baby U1's spools from the watched run.

cases.why: Baby U1 head 1: Polymaker PLA SnapSpeed, near-black
Baby U1 head 2: the light spool reads as white
a region tag takes its language
between names (FLASHFORGE Marsala): no name rather than a wrong one
Bambu Lab Mint, from the filament catalogue
Bambu Lab Pine Green, from the filament catalogue
Bambu Lab Azure, from the filament catalogue
a cyan, in Turkish (teal is a different word)
a stored name that is only a code is never shown
an unknown language falls back to English
